Old Brightland Checkpoint/Node is a checkpoint on Pegasus Line, Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line, Lima Line and The Shuttle. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas TriPaw. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid, Southern Corridor Express (Old Brightland Station), SLT Line 1511, Line 1512, Line 1514, Line 1516 Old Brightland Central and SLT Line 1511, Line 1514 Enterprise Stops.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2500th page of this wiki.
  • The Color scheme of this station alludes to Satori Komeiji, a character from Touhou Project.
  • This station began as a node and has been expanded twice.
  • The Los Sengas Coffee of this station was located at the Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line Concourse. However, it has since been relocated to the Pegasus Line, Lima Line Concourse after its expansion.
  • A set of lavatories existed at the north end of The Shuttle Concourse. However, since the Pegasus Line, Lima Line Part extension, the lavatories have been removed to provide a connection to the Shopping Street.
  • This station is the permanent down direction terminus of Akashi Line. However, the Turn Back Sidings for Akashi Line of this station aren't constructed until the Daybreaker Line Extension to Stivali Peninsula Station.
  • This station is the first station to have its in-station transit built during an expansion. The in-station transit for this station is not built until the Pegasus Line , Lima Line expansion.
  • Exit E of this station is uni-directional.
  • Prior to the establishment of Lima Line, Spoilers of its route can be seen at the Pegasus Line, Lima Line Station Control Room of this station.

History[]

  • May 10 2020: This Station began construction.
  • May 11 2020: The Shuttle part of this station copmleted construction. At the same day, this station began services alongside Metropolis Link.
  • June 13 2020: This station had been sabotaged.[5]
  • August 9 2020: The Shuttle Concourse, Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line Concourse and Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line Platforms of this station completed construction.
  • August 12 2020: Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line are established.
  • October 19 2021: The Shuttle section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • March 19 2022: The Pegasus Line, Lima Line Part of this station began expansion.
  • March 20 2022: This Station copmleted the expansion of the Pegasus Line and Lima Line Part. During the expansion, an in-station transit and a Shopping Street are added to this station.[7]
  • March 21 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Colon Station to this station, but Lima Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 25 2024: Exit K is added to this station.
  • August 8 2024: This station became a Checkpoint. At the same day, this station completed setting up of Lima Line systems.
  • August 9 2024: This station completed setting up of Lima Line systems, but as Lima Line is not yet connected to another station, Platforms 9, 10 remain reserved.
  • August 14 2024: Lima Line is established.

Old Brightland Station is a station of Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid and Southern Corridor Express. It is operated by Nawis Railway, and is located at Los Sengas TriPaw. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line, The Shuttle, Lima Line (Old Brightland Checkpoint/Node) and SLT Line 1511, Line 1512, Line 1514, Line 1516 (Old Brightland Central Stop).

Oldon Town Station is a station on Wanderer Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to PTT. Railway Greenwood Line (Oldon Town Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, alongside Recuérdame Station, uses Reverse Basic PSDs.[2]
  • The Arch Ceilings and light color scheme of the ceilings and the walls adopts the British Style Design.[3]
  • The Station Name Sign of this Station is inspired by the London Underground to allude to the name of this station as Oldon Town is built with a British Style.

History[]

  • December 18 2021: This station completed construction.[4]
  • December 19 2021: This station began services.
  • April 8 2022: Exit A2 is added to this station to connect to the PTT. Railway Station of the Same Name.[5]

Ontario Sound Station is a station on Xofa Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Teraleros. This station will serve Tachyon Line in the future.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be built in Teraleros.
  • The name of this station alludes to the Canadian Province of the Same Name.
  • If Spin-offs and Pre-Season 4 Stations are NOT considered, this station is the last station to be built in Season 3. However, when Pre-Season 4 Stations are considered, the last station to be built in Season 3 is Mangkhut Sound Station, and the last stop to be built in Season 3 is Tin Kam Court Stop.

History[]

  • July 13 2023: This Station began construction.
  • July 16 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • July 17 2023: This station began services alongside Xofa Line, but Tachyon Line Platforms remain reserved.

Orama Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Road
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Future Development
  • 5 History
  • 6 Citations and References

Location[]

Orama Island is an octagonal island surrounded by four different islands in the Centopia District. It is sandwiched by Centopia Island to the east, Leben Island to the south, Relish Island to the west and Hakeem Island to the north.

Transport[]

Railway[]

Currently, this island does not feature any railway access.

Road[]

In terms of access roads, this island is connected by road from Hakeem Island to the north, Leben Island to the south and Relish Island to the west. Moreover, the road connection heading towards Centopia Island to the east also features a pedestrian footbridge at the middle of the two ways of the road which leads to Centopia.

In terms of roads within the island, this island features a two-lane dual carriageway ring road at the outskirts of the island, with a roundabout to the east of this ring road and another two-lane dual carriageway cutting through the ring in a diagonal fashion from the northeast to the southwest. The diagonal road also features a single-lane two-way road and yet another east-west oriented two-lane dual carriageway that connects to a roundabout and the ring road to the west respectively, as well as providing potential connection to Relish Island. The roundabout connected to the diagonal road is also connected to the ring road from three sides, with the north side and the south side leading to the Leben Island connection road and the east side leading to the east roundabout of the ring road.

Overall, while the roads on this island are not in a regular grid-like pattern, it forms the outlining shape of a Nazca Railway icon.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this island Orama is taken from the Greek language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Vision".[2]
  • The channel that exists between Centopia Island to the east and this island is 400m wide.
  • As no new stations were involved on this island at the time of NR Headquarters Phase 2 Development, the construction of roads on this island have been sub-contracted.
  • If Aerial Images are captured from above this island, the icon of Nazca Railway could be seen, corresponding to the fact that this island will house the Nazca Railway Headquarters in the future.

Future Development[]

When the Chinese Name of this island, Vision, is considered, it implies that the Nazca Railway Headquarters may be built on this island in the future.

History[]

  • October 14 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • November 5 2023: This island completed road pavement.
  • November 19 2023: The road link to Hakeem Island completed construction.
  • November 30 2023: The footbridge to Centopia completed construction.
  • December 2 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • December 18 2023: The road link to Leben Island completed construction.

Origin Court Station is a station on Pegasus Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 102 Golden Origin and Origin Court stops. Alternatively, passengers may also use the Origin Underground Street to connect to Nazca Railway East Ring Line (Origin Pond Station), New Edward Line (City Origin Station), Stadium Line, Arcgo Line, Origin Line (Origin Station) and Katadelphia Railway Lincity Line (Origin Forest Station).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Confluence of the Inner Lands".

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features the first set of Nazca Railway Connecting Stations outside the Gate Area. Passengers may make use of the Origin Underground Street to change to Origin Station, City Origin Station and Origin Pond Station.
  • Previous contenders for the English name of this station included Central Origin Station[3], Golden Origin Station[4] and Origin Underground Street Station[5]. However, the first name is scrapped as, while this station is located at the geological center of Origin Station, City Origin Station and Origin Pond Station, calling this station Central Origin would cause confusion with Origin Station. Moreover, this station is also a sizable distance from Golden Origin, and with the word length of Origin Underground Street being too long, the latter two names are scrapped as well.
  • Despite being located directly beneath Origin Court, which is the namesake of this station, none of the exits of this station lead directly to Origin Court above.
  • While Exits A, B and C all lead to Origin Underground Street, their arranged stations is based on the layout of the Origin Underground Street. It leads passengers to the nearest connecting station from that direction.
  • As the result of the construction of this station, Exits V and W are added to the Metropolis Terminal Underground Walkway to connect to Origin Underground Street.

History[]

  • May 21 2022: This Station completed construction.[6]
  • May 22 2022: This Station began services.
  • June 5 2026: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[7]

Origin Forest Station is a station on Lincity Line. It is operated by Katadelphia Railway, and is located in Los Sengas Katadelphia. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway New Edward Line (City Origin Station) and Line 301 City Origin NR Station and Origin Forest stops. Alternatively, passengers may also use the Origin Underground Street to connect to Nazca Railway East Ring Line (Origin Pond Station), Stadium Line, Arcgo Line, Origin Line (Origin Station) and Pegasus Line (Origin Court Station).

Description[]

Origin Line is one of the auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line passes through Downtown, Katadelphia, Flask and Internal Sea.

This route is represented by Magenta on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 13.

Currently, this route is 15.095 km long, with a total of 7 stations.

History[]

Development Chapters[]

  • S2E11: Metropolis - Flask North
  • S3E9: Metropolis - Sand Martin (Kamelen Inserted between Origin and Flask North)
  • S3E11: Wilde Street - Sand Martin
  • S3E18: Wilde Street - Sand Martin (Samenta Inserted between Origin and Kamelen)

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Daisy Island Station, passing through the south of Bowplate River, Flamelute Island and Torrent North in the process. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Eastwards from Sand Martin Checkpoint to Daisy Island Station. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Downtown
  • Katadelphia
  • Flask
  • Internal Sea

Line Charcteristics[]

  • The Auxiliary Standard Railway Line for the Hub Railway of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Alpha Line and Fox Line(East): Metropolis to Sand Martin (Alpha Line: Through Katadelphia North and Zootuary) (Fox Line: Through Flask North)
  • Among the express services of this line, Fox Line runs parallel with this line.
  • This line features four consecutive stations with a naturally-spawned village near the station, namely Station of Frienship (Warmfox Shoal Village), Far River Station (Far River Village), Banyan Station (Banyan Village) and Sand Martin Checkpoint (Sand Martin Village).

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was originally Line Number 14.
  • This line may extend to Daisy Island Station of East Ring Line in the future.
  • The former Terracept Division of Nazca Railway also had a line of the same name with a nearly identical color scheme (Origin Line).
  • This line used to be the only Standard Railway Line to pass through Katadelphia without having any stations there. At the time, Origin Station at Downtown and Flask North Station at Flask were neighboring stations. However, Kamelen Station (Closer to the Flask North side) and Samenta Station (Closer to the Origin side) were added onto this line in 2020 and 2022 respectively, with the latter being an interchange stations with Pegasus Line.

Origin Line was the third line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Semilunar Tip and Fare Well Cliff, and had a total of 15 stations. It was established alongside Sky Castle Station on October 8 2012. Moreover, a branch between Youngland and Lighthouse was set up on this branch, which commenced services on May 21 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Origin Line was the third District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from southeast Terracept to northwest Terracept, with the northwestern route travelling along the coastline.

This line was represented by the Magenta Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 3.

At the time of its closure, this route was 18.109 km long, with a total of 15 stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is named after the fact that this line passes through the original spawn point of Terracept, namely Origin.
  • There is a line that shares both the Chinese Name and English Name (Origin Line) with this line in Los Sengas Division, and is named after the same reason.

Origin Pond Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway Lincity Line (Origin Forest Station). Alternatively, passengers may also use the Origin Underground Street to connect to Nazca Railway New Edward Line (City Origin Station), Stadium Line, Arcgo Line, Origin Line (Origin Station) and Pegasus Line (Origin Court Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 4
  • Find the origin point from a set of 3D Cartesian Coordinates.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a piece of paper.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Position
    • Button

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 3
  • This time, there are two extra axles besides of the existing X-Axis and Y-Axis.
  • Only when you turn around can you find the truth.
  • Look for the answer at other stations of the Origin Series.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Compass.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first Pseudoground Station ever built.

History[]

  • June 3 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[9]
  • November 19 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[10]
  • May 22 2022: A covered walkway is added at Exit A to connect this station with Origin Underground Street and Origin Court Station.[11]
  • September 24 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[12]
  • November 9 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[13]

Origin Station is a station on Stadium Line, Arcgo Line and Origin Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway Lincity Line (Origin Forest Station) and SLT Line 1L, Line 102, Line 103 Origin NR Station Stop. Alternatively, passengers may also use the Origin Underground Street to connect to Nazca Railway East Ring Line (Origin Pond Station), New Edward Line (City Origin Station) and Pegasus Line (Origin Court Station).

  • Make use of the Cartesian Coordinate System that you have learned from Middle School, and you will realize that knowing the X and Y coordinates are enough.
  • Look for the answer at other stations of the Origin Series.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Compass.

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station alludes to the Terracept Division Station of the same name.
  • This station is named after the fact that it is located near the point at which Nazca (The builder of Nazca Railway) first emerged at Los Sengas.

History[]

  • May 1 2015: This station began services alongside Stadium Line and Arcgo Line. Arcgo Line is established.
  • March 13 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • January 17 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[7]
  • January 23 2017: This station completed expansion. During the expansion, two side platforms are added for Origin Line.
  • February 12 2017: Origin Line is established.
  • June 10 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • October 31 2017: Exits A to C of this staiton are reopened, connecting to Origin Underground Street and Origin Government Office.[9]
  • May 22 2022: A covered walkway is set up at Exit D1 to connect to Origin Underground Street and Origin Court Station.[10]
  • June 5 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[11]
  • September 23 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[12]
  • October 2 2022: Exit E3 is added to this station to connect to Origin NR Station Stop.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built at Mainland Egress.
  • A stage is built at this station to allude to the theme of the Chinese Name of this station.
  • A large-scaled Nazca Railway icon is built near this station to commemorate the completion of East Ring Line.

History[]

  • May 29 2017: This station completed structural and electromechanical works.[2]
  • May 31 2017: This station began services.
  • October 1 2017: Nazca Railway held The "East Ring Line Completion Ceremony" in this station.[3]
  • August 1 2023: After 5 years and 10 months sharp, the Warp for Nazca Railway Season 3 and Project Nazca eleventh anniversary Photoshoot is held at the stage of this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that a ring-shaped river exist at the location of this station. To pay tribute to this, a moat is constructed around the East Ring Line Platform structure of this station.
  • Chairs that say "Please be Seated" are seen at the Platforms of this station.

History[]

  • October 6 2016: This station completed construction.[3]
  • October 9 2016: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • June 20 2022: This station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line Part. During the Expansion, a set of Side Platforms, one concoruse and six exits are added.[4]
  • June 21 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Eastbiome Station to this station.
  • June 13 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • Among the existing Los Sengas Division stations, this station uses the most colored wool despite its black livery (Red Wool, Orange Wool, Yellow Wool, Lime Wool, Light Blue Wool, Blue Wool, Purple Wool, Magenta Wool, Pink Wool).
  • This station is built to commemorate an administrator in Project Nazca who is also named Edward and is highly proficient at Redstone Machinery[2], hence the presence of Blocks of Redstone in this station. In Los Sengas Division, there are four other stations that are built to commemorate different people in Project Nazca who are named Edward and had contributed to this server, namely Comp Ward, Comic Ward, Edward Island and Ani Ward.
  • The multi-colored wool in this station refer to an Earthquake grading system in Los Sengas that is set up by the same Edward that this station is meant to commemorate.[3]

History[]

  • September 26 2015: This station began services.
  • August 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • August 14 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 24 2022: Exit A of this station completed reconstruction.[6]
  • December 2 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Parallel Bay Station is a station on East Ring Line and Egress Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Egress. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2001 (Parallel Bay Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built surrounding the concept of Parallelograms.[2] As a result, Parallelograms are seen at the ceilings of the station, and the platforms are also parallelogram-shaped. As a result, The Platform Screen Door Control of the East Ring Line and Egress Line Platform do not align in a straight line, in turn reducing the running speed of passengers and reducing the risk of injury when passengers run into trains. Moreover, trains for both East Ring Line and Egress Line travel at the same direction, causing a Parallel Cross-Platform Interchange.
  • To the East side of the station, Sidings for East Ring Line and Egress Line exist for trains to go to Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings at both floors in order to let trains turn back in that stabling siding instead of at the main tracks, which could affect train services.
  • Sidings for Egress Line exist to the west between this station and River Rendezvous Station. It is accessible from Platform 2 of that station, and beneath the east of Exits A1 and A2 of this station.
  • This station is the last station to be built without ImageOnMap (IoM) Signs.

History[]

  • July 24 2017: This station began services. Egress Line is established.
  • July 8 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first Oceanfloor Station located in East Los Sengas (To the East of Urban Line).[5] Moreover, this Station is also surrounded by Underwater Tunnels from all sides, namely the Gun-Peace Tunnel, the Artillery-peace Tunnel, the Sava Peacean Tunnel, the Flask Peacean Tunnel and the Portu-peace Tunnel.
  • The Sava Line, Flask Line Platforms of this station adopts the Cross-platform interchange arrangements, and while Sava Line uses left-hand traffic rules, Flask Line, starting from Glacier Station, uses Right-hand Traffic rules.
  • This Station is the permanent Up Direction Terminus of Sava Line.
  • This Station is the first Island Station to be built under the Seabed regarding the Pegasus Line part.
  • This Station is the first Island Station to feature two platform passageways for each platform. For each platform, the west passageway connects to the Concourse, whereas the east passageway connects to the Transfer Passageway towards Sava Line, Flask Line Platforms.

History[]

  • May 30 2021: This Station began construction.
  • June 2 2021: This Station completed construction.[6]
  • June 4 2021: This Station began services alongside Sava Line, but Flask Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • June 9 2021: Flask Line extends from Glacier Station to this station through Artillery Island Station.
  • July 4 2022: This station completed expansion. During the expansion, several transfer passageways and a set of stacked side platforms are added for Pegasus Line.[7] At the same day, Pegasus Line extends from Portubra Island Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this station alludes to the fact that this station does not use any stairs (steps). All connections between the exits, concourse and platforms of this station are made by elevators.
  • The Chinese Name of this station is a play on words of the name of Terracept Division Leisura Step Station.
  • This station is the last station to be built in 2016.
  • This station is located on an island.

History[]

  • December 31 2016: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line.
  • August 22 2025: This station began expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • August 23 2025: This station completed expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • August 25 2025: Coopol Line extends from Skycold Rivulet Station to this station.

Nazca Railway 2020 Day Event Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Q: What is the name of Type VII Station?
  • A: Oceanfloor
  • A Door Opening Sound indicates that you have answered correctly.
  • The 2020 Day Event Souvenir comes in the form of a Redstone Torch.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is one of the two stations chosen for the 2020 Day Event due to the fact that this station is built in May 15, as 5+15=20, with the other station chosen being Sand-O Bay Station due to it being the 20th Station built in Season 2.
  • Due to Geographical Limitations and lack of underground space on the island, the Concourse of this station is located directly beneath the platforms, making it the first concourse in Nazca Railway to be located at Sea Level.
  • This Station is the first Los Sengas Coffee in Nazca Railway to feature a "Stomachache Queue Jumper".
  • "Peanut Seats" are set up at the sides of the Concourse to allude to the Cantonese slang of "Let's have some peanuts while watching movies", which refers to the act of not lifting a finger or watching arguments from the sidelines. In English, the Same Quote is translated to "Grabbing some Popcorn".

History[]

  • May 18 2019: This Station began services.
  • November 29 2023: Exit C is added to this station to connect to the Kirameki Electric Railway Station of the Same Name.
